6274.title: Markdown fragment navigation
6274.rootCauseOneLine: Fragment clicks remain uncanceled with a new-tab target; renderer destinations and cross-file fragments are lost.

prReviews.verdict: Closed, unmerged; static review only; cross-file fragment loss is outside its scope.

6274.proposedFix: Handle same-document fragments within their preview; preserve sanitized targets and define heading IDs; extend shared file navigation separately to carry cross-file destinations.
6274.caveats: Two clean trusted-main renderer runs reproduced four failures; 117 existing tests passed. Chromium was unavailable, so actual browser tabs and scrolling were not verified. No simple-fix PR: complete cross-file support needs a public file-location contract extension.
